title: Ahead of US midterms, ChatGPT draws images "depicting election interference or that may discourage voting" in a cartoon style, ignoring photorealism requests (Katelyn Chedraoui/CNET)
summary: Katelyn Chedraoui / CNET: Ahead of US midterms, ChatGPT draws images “depicting election interference or that may discourage voting” in a cartoon style, ignoring photorealism requests — ChatGPT is cracking down on photorealistic, political deepfakes ahead of next week's US midterm elections. — Reporter 2
contentText:
Katelyn Chedraoui / CNET :

Ahead of US midterms, ChatGPT draws images “depicting election interference or that may discourage voting” in a cartoon style, ignoring photorealism requests   —  ChatGPT is cracking down on photorealistic, political deepfakes ahead of next week's US midterm elections.  —  Reporter 2
